_COMMENT_SOURCE: Per 100 g, commercially prepared enriched butter cookie (USDA-derived, via myfooddata.com): water 4.7, protein 6.2, fat 19.1, carbohydrate 70 (sugars ~20.4, fiber ~0.8), sodium ~286 mg (= ~0.73 g NaCl). Mapping: STARCH = carbohydrate - sugars (fiber lumped into STARCH), SALT = sodium x 2.54. Fractions are MASS fractions of the solids; FRACTIONS_BASIS = 'MASS' makes the study convert them to volume fractions (ingredient densities) and add AIR_VOLUME_FRACTION.
_COMMENT_GRID: A 50 mm product needs a wider domain than the 50 mm default so it keeps the same ~5 mm clearance to the PML (N_PML + N_PML_MARGIN = 35 cells x dx ~0.14 mm) that the earlier 30 mm cylinder had: 50 mm + 2 x ~5 mm + margin -> 70 mm. L_Z_GRID is unchanged. Roughly doubles the cell count per run.
